title: Engineering Standards — Stack Catalog
description: Canonical, language-neutral catalog of the (language, framework, pinned-version) stacks the standards corpus ships for. This file is BOTH a JSON Schema (it validates the shape of stack descriptor objects via `$defs/StackDescriptor`) AND the live catalog (the four canonical stacks are pinned via `properties.stacks.const`). The Python compiler (`compiler/core/stack_filter.py`) and the Node consumer sync CLI (`packages/standards-sync/`) both load this file as their stack catalog so the two implementations cannot drift. Adding a fifth stack is a one-entry append to `stacks.const` PLUS a new fixture under `fixtures/` PLUS a new golden tree under `tests/golden/`.
$comment: Phase 8 deliverable per `docs/02-implementation-plan.md` §11 task 1 (Phase-7 lesson §7-b — single source of truth for the stack catalog). Adding this file eliminates the previous duplication between `compiler.core.stack_filter.STACKS` and `tools.generate_dist_readme.KNOWN_STACKS`; both now read this catalog at startup, and the Phase-7 drift guard (`tests/test_generate_dist_readme.py::test_known_stacks_align_with_compiler_stack_filter`) becomes a trivial identity check. The Node CLI consumes the same file via `require('../../../schemas/stacks.json')` (or via a copy bundled at publish time — see `packages/standards-sync/package.json::files`).

stacks.description: Array of stack descriptors. Order is significant only for human readability; the compiler and the sync CLI key lookups by `id`.

const.description: Modern Spring Boot 3.x microservices using Spring Data JPA, Validation, and Lombok.
Legacy Spring Boot 2.7.x services mid-migration to 3.x — narrower rule set.

id.description: Stable stack identifier (kebab-case, lowercase). The compiler emits to `dist/stacks/<id>/`; consumers receive this id in the sync report.

language.description: Primary programming language for the stack. Matches `scope.language` in source-rule frontmatter.

framework.description: Framework identifier within the language. Matches `scope.framework` in source-rule frontmatter.

framework_version.description: Pinned full semver against which `scope.framework_version` ranges are matched. The compiler keeps this as a single concrete version; the sync CLI's detection logic uses the descriptor's `detection.indicators[].version_range` to recognise the stack in the wild.

human_name.description: Human-readable name used in the README index and in the Cursor MDC `description` line.

detection.description: Recipe the consumer-sync CLI uses to recognise this stack from a project manifest. Read by `packages/standards-sync/src/detect-stack.js`. Not read by the Python compiler.

manifest_files.description: Manifest filenames to look for in the consumer's project root. ANY match opens the file for indicator evaluation; ALL indicators in the descriptor must then match for the stack to be selected.

indicators.description: Recognisable signals in a manifest file that confirm this stack. The sync CLI evaluates indicators top-to-bottom; the FIRST matching indicator selects the stack (subsequent indicators are not consulted). This list is therefore ordered most-specific-first.

StackIndicator.description: One detection signal. Each `kind` is interpreted by a corresponding detector module in `packages/standards-sync/src/detect-stack.js`.
